BiblicalUsage: I will ransom them from the power of the grave, says the LORD; O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction. The word is the extermination itself — and God turns it on death.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God will be death's plague and the grave's destruction, and Hosea's taunt is the gospel in advance.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
